summary: Add offline PTX instruction reference with original explanations and Lean source; clarify the general squared-affine README example and incoming derivative.

examined.reason: Clarified the incoming derivative seed and chain rule without changing formulas or theorem scope.
Added reproducible offline instruction index and original per-form explanations linked to checked Lean source, distinguishing reviewed forms from restricted models.
Documentation integrity checks add coverage, link, provenance and staleness validation; semantic fidelity and Lean proof checking remain separate.
Candidate runs still defer the accepted-form ledger, now including its derived documentation check; coordinator acceptance still requires the full check.
The child now explains an output weight as the incoming derivative; automatic exact-real construction, arbitrary tensor seed, and success/correctness obligations are unchanged.
The HTML displays the existing 219 instruction sections and precise forms separately, preserving the inventory contract and making no full-section coverage claim.

results.method: bash scripts/check.sh; git diff --check; distribution guard on all proposed files; manual README/source comparison; browser layout, search, filters and source navigation
results.environment: Linux; pinned Lean 4.34.0; system Python3; Codex in-app browser; no semantic Lean edits and no new model calls
results.evidence: Root check passed: 29 accepted forms, 79 current generated files, 4 documentation tests, 7 inventory tests, 106 worker tests, 26 reviewer tests, build and 1643 declaration axiom audit. Before/after snapshot trees identical. Documentation tests check all local links/anchors and rebuild without vendor cache, rejecting changed source hashes. Proposed-file distribution guard passed on 91 files. Browser confirmed 219 entries, reviewed/restricted/empty filters, readable index/detail/source pages and source line navigation. README seven launch bodies and theorem names checked against existing Lean programs. TorchLean integration suite was not rerun; its code is unchanged. Stratic validation is also performed during preparation.
